fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that Malathi Selvi was allegedly pushed and struck during a street argument at Roja Park Main Street. The matter was brought to Coimbatore North PS on 2025-09-13, while the incident was placed on 2025-09-11 at approximately 13:20. The complaint was lodged by Kishore Murugan (9000000326) on behalf of Malathi Selvi, whose contact number is given as 9000000386. Amudha Kannan was mentioned as a person who was present nearby, but no contact number was available. The complainant alleged that Gokul Gopal may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000195. Items referenced in the complaint: photographs and a witness statement.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly pushed the victim during a street argument.
fields.Keywords: altercation, street dispute, afternoon, witness, mobile number, photograph, suspect, main street
